description:
## Verified problem

The make_reducer even/gt2 witness settles two semantic reducer activations. Each captured predicate is carried as ValueRef and invoked through an indirect closure_call. The semantic identities and two predicate construction words are observable, but the completed native reducer and continuation graphs are equivalent. Before this ticket both graphs were materialized and code-generated separately.

The direct-carrier control mk(double) / mk(triple) is different: its lambda bodies contain distinct grounded local targets. Those graphs must not share.

## Goal

Retain every semantic activation and runtime construction identity while compiling one physical native CPS graph for sibling activations whose complete native graphs are equivalent. The sharing pass must perform bounded deterministic work and leave codegen with materially less work.

## Chosen boundary and strategy

NativeProgram is the ownership boundary. BackendProgram remains the interpreter semantic and index authority; merging there would erase semantic identity or require a parallel remap before native ABI, direct targets, construction words, and the complete CPS graph are explicit. No existing canonical key is suitable: IrFn equality includes owned function, name, and callsite allocation identities; backend canon is comparison-only and world/string based; and the JIT has no linker-level identical-code folding.

NativeProgram.executable_entries therefore keeps one ExecutableKey -> FnId row per semantic executable while permitting several rows to name one physical entry. After lowering completes, each fixed-point pass builds one ephemeral index over native bodies and IR control edges. Executable roots and clause indices seed graph ownership; continuations receive canonical roles from first-reachable completed-IR control-edge paths. Temporal continuation indices have been deleted from NativeBodyOrigin, so allocation and inventory order cannot become semantic identity. A graph containing an owned body with no structural control path is ineligible rather than receiving a guessed fallback role. The current corpus proves those cases are dead branch/resume emission and fz-tfn.27 owns deleting them at their emitter before final epic acceptance.

Comparison alpha-renames only graph-owned FnIds, diagnostic function names, and same-span callsite allocation identities. Direct targets, construction words, ABI and representation facts, effects, captures, extern marshals, and other codegen-relevant types compare exactly. A type may differ only for a ValueRef variable exhaustively proven by the IR-use walk to occur solely as the callee word of an indirect closure call.

Every accepted mapping rewrites the module entry, semantic entry map, callable-boundary targets, continuation owners, and CPS control edges; removes redundant bodies and functions; and rebuilds the module function index. Construction-producing IR is not remapped.

## Measured signal on current base 21711b335

The deterministic 502-candidate census reaches 467 native programs and 465 paired codegen successes. It finds 662 same-function sibling groups and 40 equivalent classes. Sharing preserves 5,338 semantic entries and 148 MakeClosure instructions while reducing:

- physical roots: 5,338 -> 5,281 (-57)
- continuations: 8,356 -> 8,220 (-136)
- all native bodies: 14,989 -> 14,796 (-193)
- native text: 3,483,036 -> 3,438,764 bytes (-44,272)

Repeated corrected runs produce exactly 488 ownership-index passes, 19,599 indexed bodies, 17,417 structurally reachable graph-body roles, 4,751 graph comparisons, and 4,499 body comparisons. Two clean warm samples spent 90.192 ms and 84.513 ms sharing while paired codegen fell by 170 ms and 696 ms. One isolated cold target completed successfully in 184.69 s total, including 63 s build and 120.05 s census, exit 0, with a noise-level 55 ms reversal between two roughly 19.5 s codegen passes. Deterministic body and byte removal plus bounded index/comparison counts are primary; elapsed samples are corroborative, not thresholds.

The rejected scan design did 4,924 graph comparisons, varied between 5,659 and 5,698 body comparisons across identical runs, and spent about 1,516 ms while avoiding about 1,179 ms of codegen. It is not the accepted design.

## Acceptance

- The exact even/gt2 reducer matches Elixir on interpreter, JIT, and AOT.
- The boxed pair begins as disjoint complete graphs, differs only at proven indirect-callee ValueRef types, retains both semantic activations and predicate construction words, and maps to one physical graph.
- Reversing helper and body inventory order preserves structural equivalence; detaching a real continuation control edge makes its graph ineligible, prevents fixed-point sharing, and leaves the helper and owner internally valid after unrelated remaps.
- mk(double) / mk(triple) retains two physical graphs and distinct grounded targets.
- Dynamic callable construction, capture layout, recursive-search telemetry, semantic-to-physical movement, and all current-base behavior remain green.
- The retained census reproduces the classified population and exact reductions above with deterministic work counts and no unexplained behavior movers.
- No test requires duplicate bodies.
- cargo fmt --check, strict all-target/all-feature clippy, cargo test --lib, cargo test --test fz2_cli, and the complete fixture matrix pass.

## Composition with open work

PR #113 changes only wording near native lowering and deletes orphaned semantic closure state; it does not own native graph mapping. PR #110 changes upstream semantic and dispatch inputs and may shrink the executable population, but it does not touch artifact.rs or jobs/native.rs; this pass consumes whatever closed BackendProgram it receives and conservatively rejects any newly inequivalent graph. Corpus totals must be remeasured if that upstream arc lands first.

The structural audit found genuine dead branch/resume native helpers, recorded with deletion-at-emitter acceptance in fz-tfn.27. The epic order is fz-kdt.4 -> fz-tfn.27 -> fz-tfn.24 so dead-code removal precedes final work-budget acceptance.

comments.text: Reopened during cumulative current-base review: the original normalized comparer saved 44,272 emitted bytes but temporary census instrumentation measured 4,924 graph / 5,698 body comparisons across 488 passes and ~1.516s sharing cost versus ~1.179s codegen reduction, with a ~586ms worst case and hash/early-exit-dependent comparison counts. This violates the arc performance goal. Retain the native ownership boundary, but replace repeated full-body scans with deterministic indexed/canonical ownership (or a simpler measured equivalent), remove probes, and re-run exact output/work/behavior gates before cold review and delivery.

title: Boxed captured-callable specializations duplicate native CPS bodies despite distinct semantic identities
